title: phaeonychium albiflorum

It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, contributing to the relief of various conditions like digestive issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of Phaeonychium albiflorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cytotoxic properties.
